title: Commerce Ministry identifying AI-proof professions, sectors where India can take global lead: Goyal
hook_text: India is hunting for AI-proof jobs.
script:
India is hunting for AI-proof jobs.
Minister Piyush Goyal announced a massive push to map sectors where the country can take a global lead.
The Commerce Ministry is actively identifying professions that automated tools cannot easily replace.
This strategy aims to secure long-term workforce stability and protect domestic industries from sudden disruption.
Officials want to isolate high-value domains to capture emerging economic advantages worldwide.
Which career path feels safest from automation right now?
